title: DARPA programs with nine-figure budgets going black to Site 51

tellings.quote: I had a DARPA program manager in here named John Bletch and he didn't say this. This is my speculation, but he kept having these programs in certain cases with nine-figure budgets.

plain: Some programmes at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced military research, are said to have had budgets in the hundreds of millions of dollars and, in certain cases, to have been made secret and moved to Area 51, the classified Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. The researcher John Brandenburg says this on the show. He links it to a DARPA programme manager named John Blitch who came to see him, but he says plainly that Blitch never said it and that the link to the secret site is his own guess.
